sources.title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Tencent's Open Memory-Writer Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B is a specialised language model from Tencent Hunyuan, published on Hugging Face with its technical report on 15 October 2026. It does one job: the write path of an external memory system.

sources.title: Hy-Memory 30B A3B - VRAM, Specs & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: About Hy-Memory 30B A3B Hy-Memory 30B A3B is an activation-sparse mixture-of-experts model released by Tencent designed for long-term memory retrieval and augmented reasoning. It activates 3B parameters per token to balance efficiency with deep contextual awareness.
